fusions.name: Drizzle Mist
fusions.desc: Breathes a fine mist in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Marked Downpour
fusions.desc: Drops a column of water that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Soothing Fall
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Storm Sense
fusions.desc: When something other than fire hurts you, you gain a ward that soaks 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
